firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
I am grateful to have had the opportunity to participate in such a wonderful competition alongside elites from all over the world.

This work is based on the open-access HIGH PubScore Notebook by @anvithpothula @amanatar and @crystalbaby. Throughout the process, I conducted ablation experiments, especially on post-processing and fine-tuning, exploring with Kimi K3.0 Pro.

At the 21% test-set, I was only +0.001 ahead of the highest public notebook score of 0.953. Eventually, we may all finalized at 0.920. The paper is attached at the end of this write-up, and I should humbly learn from other optimal solutions. For now, I am just an undergraduate preparing for graduate school.

TRUTH AWAITS, KEEP GOING.

Jindong Fan @sylvestervan 

DJTU, Dalian, China
